conceptRationale: The owner-approved Connected O artwork, compact lowercase oorva wordmark, and lockup proportions are supplied in the exact O01L app-asset vector masters.
geometryRationale: This revision copies the nine current-main O01L drop-in SVG masters byte-for-byte from docs/design/oorva/logo/vector/app-assets. Their vector geometry is unchanged; no redraw, trace, alternate geometry, or raster embedding was performed by this revision.

originalityProvenance.authorship: The supplied masters are the owner-approved Connected O artwork; the source README documents their upstream vectorization from the owner's own approved PNGs. This revision only copies the supplied SVG masters verbatim and does not redraw or trace raster artwork.

visualDirection.ownerFeedback: The previous logo was rejected as different; use this design as the visual direction.
visualDirection.scope: Approval establishes visual direction and a standing D03b selection rule; this O01L source revision is not itself a selected O01X export. D03c public rights clearance and PNG export approval are not granted.

originalityProvenance.copyMethod: Byte-for-byte copy of the nine approved app-assets SVGs; source and destination SHA-256 values were checked.
originalityProvenance.inputUse: The light PNG remains the owner-approved visual reference. The supplied SVG masters are authoritative drop-ins; this revision copies no PNG path, does no raster trace, and embeds no bitmap.
originalityProvenance.wordmarkConstruction: The wordmark is the supplied outlined vector path; no live text, font, external href, script, or external resource is used.

smallSizeEvidence.method: The supplied symbol is two filled cubic-Bezier subpaths. Each subpath is sampled at 120 equal t-intervals per cubic; the minimum Euclidean distance between the subpaths is measured separately in the left and right halves after the SVG path transform. logicalGapPx = minimumTransformedGapUnits * logicalSizePx / 256.

visualSource.result: Both openings are visually open at all three supplied render sizes.

smallSizeEvidence.renderingClaim: This source contact sheet was visually inspected; no new raster export or device rendering was performed by O01L.

tagline.placement: Separate app text; not part of SVG wordmark geometry or any SVG master.
tagline.fontSource: Bundled Inter 400 for separate tagline rendering; runtime font loading is not validated by O01L.

contrastEvidence.standard: WCAG relative luminance and contrast ratio for sRGB colors
contrastEvidence.channelLinearization: cLinear = cSrgb / 12.92 when cSrgb <= 0.04045; otherwise ((cSrgb + 0.055) / 1.055) ^ 2.4, where cSrgb is the 0-1 channel value.

license.customArtwork: The supplied SVG paths are the owner's approved artwork direction documented by the source README. No third-party artwork was used per that README. Trademark, public-use, ownership, and redistribution clearance are not asserted; D03c is NOT_APPROVED.
license.taglineFont: Bundled Inter Regular 400 is referenced only as a separate app text recommendation; no font file is embedded in the SVG masters.
license.explorationPngs: The PNGs remain references, not copied assets in this revision. O01L copied the supplied SVG drop-ins byte-for-byte. D03c is NOT_APPROVED and continues to block public/store release only.

approvalStatus.D03bSelectionRule: Any O01X set faithfully reproducing the owner-approved Connected O artwork and passing all A.4.1 checks is selected without further owner choice.
approvalStatus.D03bCandidateEvidence: O01X candidate export and candidate-specific hashes/validation will be recorded after this source revision is green.
approvalStatus.D03cScope: Blocks public launch/store listing only; it does not block development, private integration, main promotion, or owner testing.
